Use case: identity-preserve. ONE single transparent native-HD full body animation frame of 07 Moon Shadow Assassin Girl, NOT a sheet, no multiple figures. Input1=new run E01 identity/scale/camera reference, Input2=old E01 costume identity, Input3=primary approved painterly STYLE (use illustration rendering only; no UI or other characters). Frame of a 16-frame two-step run towards screen RIGHT, exact E SIDE view, near limbs are anatomical RIGHT, far limbs LEFT. Native square canvas at least 1024x1024, ideally identical 1254x1254. True transparent RGBA background, no text/shadow/platform/speed trails. Fixed root x=50%, virtual contact ground at y=94% native canvas (then fixed canvas export); keep exact camera, face size, head/body proportions and approximately identical subject size to Input1, reserve all blade/hair/scarf tips inside canvas. Preserve silver bob, single curved ahoge, purple side-profile eye, navy/gold/cream robe, scarf, crescent buckle and cyan beads/blue tassel. Hair ornament belongs ONLY to anatomical LEFT (far) side and is mostly occluded behind hair in E: only a tiny rear gold tip, no new near-side ornament. Two separate crescent daggers, exactly one locked to each gripping hand; blades move with wrists, no added or missing fingers/weapons. Running arms should be relaxed and flexed about 75-105 degrees at elbow, with shoulders moving opposite the corresponding leg; dagger blade kept outside torso safely, never a fixed arms-wide showcase. Torso leans 10 degrees forwards, natural shoulder/pelvis counter-rotation. Keep the same gentle smile, clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted finish, light and palette of reference. This is running locomotion not an attack, jump attack or parade high-knee step. Redraw the specifically requested phase; do not just duplicate the initial contact. All pose differences must be real articulated drawing, no mirror/copy/warp/interpolation.
FRAME E11 OF 16 ONLY: LEFT single support, most compressed mid-stance. It is a COMPACT running passing pose, not extended contact and not a high-knee pose.
The far anatomical LEFT leg is the only grounded leg. Its bent knee compresses under the torso and its boot is flat exactly under pelvis. The NEAR anatomical RIGHT leg is recovering beneath the body: right thigh nearly VERTICAL pointed DOWN; right knee LOW directly under the pelvis, NOT raised in front. Bend the right lower leg backward so RIGHT BOOT is elevated behind the left calf, heel tucked halfway toward buttock. The right knee is only beginning to cross from behind to ahead of the supporting left knee. Do not put the right knee at belt height.
NEAR anatomical RIGHT shoulder and sleeve must be in the FRONT: rotate its upper arm diagonally down-forward to screen-right. Flex the right elbow90 degrees and place RIGHT gripping fist directly ahead of the waist, lower than chest. Far LEFT elbow and crescent-dagger fist are near the rear hip, slightly behind torso. The near/right hand stays ahead of the far/left hand during this frame; it has not yet swung backward. Explicitly reverse the near arm arrangement of Input1. No straight arms-wide position. Pelvis 1.6% lower than frame01 due to support knee compression, same head/body dimensions. LEFT boot supports at fixed y94% virtual ground. Full two daggers and silhouette clear.
